name: Moonlighting Management
description: Manage moonlighting night shift signups, generate schedules, and export assignments
features: View all moonlighting signups by month and provider
Filter signups by date range, provider, shift
View signup statistics and coverage metrics

sub_modules.name: Signups
sub_modules.description: View and export all moonlighting signups

use_cases: Reviewing provider availability for night shifts
Running optimizer to generate monthly schedules
api_endpoints: GET /api/moonlighting/signups - Get all signups with filters

moonlighting_system.description: Night shift coverage system separate from Service Weeks
moonlighting_system.providers: Faculty who volunteer for night shifts
moonlighting_system.optimizer: PuLP-based optimizer assigns providers to maximize coverage
moonlighting_system.constraints: Desired nights, locked dates, provider preferences

notes: Moonlighting is completely separate from Service Weeks system
Optimizer respects locked dates and desired night counts
Exports use CSV format for Excel compatibility
